text: Testing plays a key role in software development. Unit tests check small parts of code, like a single function, to make sure they work correctly. Integration tests go further and check how different parts of a system work together. Many developers use test-driven development, where they write tests before writing the actual code. This approach helps them find problems early. When tests are well written, developers feel more confident about making changes, because they know the tests will catch mistakes. In short, good testing gives teams the confidence to improve their software without fear of breaking it.
